title: Weekly programming assignments with peer review and GenAI use
summary: Students solve weekly procedural-programming assignments, submit them in Moodle, and review peers' work. Students independently chose whether and how to use GenAI for generating, tracing, completing, or checking solutions; assignment and review points gate eligibility for the final exam.

sources.title: Novice Learners of Programming and Generative AI - Prior Knowledge Matters
sources.evidence_quote: Students have to solve weekly assignments and submit them via Moodle; a peer-review process follows.

context.learner_level: novice students across computing and applied-science programs

assessment.summary: Complete weekly C# programming assignments and peer reviews.
student_actions: Review and provide feedback on peers' submissions.
Optionally use GenAI while solving or reviewing.

student_role.description: Students reported several actual GenAI strategies, but the paper does not state a formal permission policy.

grading.method: Students earned points for solutions and peer feedback; a threshold was required to sit the final exam.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.

reported_results: 166 of roughly 350 students completed the survey linking GenAI-use patterns, prior experience, and exam outcomes.
